title: Knitting-circle instructions for either hand
titleZh: 兩種慣用手都適用的編織小組說明
passage: A quick note for anyone joining tonight’s knitting circle. I put two instruction sheets on the table. They make the same striped square, but they show the yarn coming from opposite sides. Pick the drawing that matches the hand you use to feed the yarn. If you switch sheets halfway through, don’t start the square over. Keep the same stitch count and carry on from the row you’ve already reached. The numbered lines match across the two sheets. If the picture still feels backwards, come and sit opposite me. You can watch my hands face to face rather than try to copy them from behind.
passageZh: 給今晚參加編織小組的各位一個提醒。我放了兩份說明在桌上。兩份都會織出同樣的條紋方片，但圖上引線的方向相反。請按你平常拿毛線的那隻手選圖。 如果織到一半換了說明單，不用從頭織。針數不變，從你目前織到的那一列繼續。兩份說明單上的列號一一對應。 如果圖看起來還是反的，就來坐我對面。你可以面對面看我的手，不必站在我背後跟著做。
